# Story Refinement Findings — Template

> **File naming:** store each report as `SI-<story-id>-<slug>-refinement-findings.md` (example: `SI-20250517-01-01-web-mockup-refinement-findings.md`).

**Story ID:** <!-- e.g., SI-20250517-01 -->  
**Story Title:** <!-- brief name -->  
**Implementation Artifact:** <!-- link to code path(s) or report -->  
**Reviewer:** <!-- your name -->  
**Review Date:** <!-- YYYY-MM-DD -->  
**Status Recommendation:** <!-- keep as-is | needs refinement | follow-up story -->

## 1. Snapshot Summary
- **Observed Outcome:** <!-- one-liner describing current behaviour -->
- **Intended Outcome:** <!-- requirement or spec highlight -->
- **Gap Statement:** <!-- concise mismatch or risk -->

| # | Area / File | Severity* | Finding | Evidence (line / behaviour) | Proposed Refinement |

| 2.2 |  |  |  |  |  |
| 2.3 |  |  |  |  |  |

> *Severity guidance: **High** (blocks requirement / creates defect), **Medium** (partial compliance / risky), **Low** (polish / documentation).
